content: 1 To the chiefe musition vpon Neginoth of Dauid. Heare my crying O Lorde: geue eare vnto my prayer. 2 From the endes of the earth I wyll call vnto thee when my heart is in heauines: oh set me vp on the rocke that is higher then I. 3 For thou hast ben my hope: and a strong towre for me against the face of the enemie. 4 I wyll dwell in thy tabernacle for euer: my trust shalbe vnder the couering of thy wynges. Selah. 5 For thou O Lorde hast hearde my vowes: and hast geuen an heritage vnto those that feare thy name. 6 Thou wilt adde dayes vnto the kings dayes: and his yeres shalbe a generation and a generation. 7 He shall dwell before the Lorde for euer: O appoynt thy louing mercy and faithfulnes, that thei may preserue him. 8 So wyll I sing psalmes vnto thy name: that I may day by day perfourme my vowes.
